newsitem.title: USA: Torotel to restructure and take charge.
newsitem.headline: Torotel to restructure and take charge.

text.p: Torotel Inc said on Friday it would would take a charge in its second quarter to restructure its Torotel Products subsidiary and because of a change in that unit's revenue recognition accounting method.
The company, which makes power supplies and magnetic components for power conversion, said it would take a one-time $250,000 restructuring charge, or about $0.09 per share, in the second quarter.
In addition, Torotel said it would take a $506,000 non-cash charge, or about $0.18 per share, for the change to accrual accounting.
As a result, Torotel said it now expected to report a consolidated loss in the second quarter.
The company was restructuring the Torotel Products unit to make operations more profitable, it said.
"We expect restructuring to generate annual savings of about $240,000 at Torotel Products, which means it will pay for itself within a year," said Chief Operating Officer Christian Hughes.
To restructure, Torotel said it would convert manual processes into an integrated information system. It had already cut management staff and reduced manufacturing overhead, it said.
